description: End-to-end workflow to onboard, manage, and operate partner agencies and intercept requests in a telco lawful intercept context.

partner_id.description: Unique identifier for a partner agency (e.g., law enforcement or regulatory body).

intercept_request_id.description: Unique identifier for a lawful intercept request.

authorization_id.description: Identifier for a legal authorization or warrant associated with an intercept request.

case_id.description: Identifier for the investigation/case under which intercepts are requested.

subject_id.description: Internal identifier for an intercept subject (target) mapped from identifiers like MSISDN/IMSI/IMEI).

delivery_channel_id.description: Identifier for a configured delivery channel (e.g., ETSI HI2/HI3 interface) for a partner.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier for an audit log event.

partner_contact.description: Contact details for a partner agency representative.

role.description: Role or title of the contact person.

pgp_key_id.description: Identifier for the PGP key used for secure communications, if applicable.

legal_authorization.description: Common structure for legal authorization metadata.

issuing_authority.description: Name of the court or authority issuing the authorization.

reference_number.description: Reference number on the legal document.

documents.description: List of document references associated with this authorization.

hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the document for integrity verification.

storage_uri.description: Location of the stored document (e.g., secure object store URI).

subject_identifier.description: Identifier used to describe an intercept target.

functions.name: register_partner_agency
functions.description: Onboard a new partner agency, including identity, credentials, and delivery capabilities.

agency_name.description: Official name of the partner agency.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction in which the agency is authorized to request intercepts.

items.description: Sub-national regions (state/province/circle) where the agency operates.

technical_profile.description: Technical capabilities of the partner for intercept delivery.

network_endpoints.description: Endpoints through which intercept content and metadata will be delivered.

compliance_constraints.description: Compliance rules specific to this partner.

requires_dual_approval.description: Whether internal dual control is required before activating intercepts.

functions.returns: Partner ID and full partner profile as registered in the system.

functions.name: configure_partner_delivery_channel
functions.description: Create or update a delivery channel configuration for a partner agency.

delivery_channel_id.description: Existing delivery channel identifier to update. Omit to create a new channel.

cert_ref.description: Reference to certificate used for mutual TLS.

functions.returns: Delivery channel ID and effective configuration after validation.

functions.name: create_intercept_request
functions.description: Create a new lawful intercept request associated with an existing partner and case, including subjects and legal authorization.

intercept_scope.description: Scope and type of intercept requested.

start_time.description: Requested start time for intercept activation.

end_time.description: Requested end time or null for open-ended (subject to policy).

geographic_constraints.description: Optional restrictions on where the intercept applies.

delivery_preferences.description: Preferences for delivery channel and frequency.

internal_routing.description: Internal classification to route the intercept within the operator.

functions.returns: Intercept request ID, initial status (e.g., PENDING_REVIEW), and a summary of the created request.

functions.name: validate_intercept_compliance
functions.description: Run automated compliance checks on a newly created or modified intercept request.

run_policy_sets.description: Optional list of specific policy sets to evaluate. If omitted, all applicable policies are run.

context_overrides.description: Optional override data for what-if or manual checks (e.g., override current date).

functions.returns: Compliance evaluation result including pass/fail status, per-policy outcomes, and required remediations if any.

functions.name: approve_or_reject_intercept_request
functions.description: Record human approval or rejection decision for an intercept request following compliance and legal review.

decider.description: Details of the approving authority or reviewer.

required_changes.description: If decision is request_changes, list of required modifications.

field_path.description: JSON path to the field that needs change.

dual_control.description: If dual approval is required, track both approvers.

is_final_approval.description: Indicates if this decision completes the dual control requirement.

prior_approval_id.description: Reference to the previous approval decision record if any.

functions.returns: Updated approval status of the intercept request, including any pending dual approvals or requested changes.

functions.name: activate_intercept
functions.description: Provision and activate an approved intercept request on network elements and mediation platforms.

schedule.description: Schedule details if activation_mode is scheduled.

network_scope.description: Optional override of target network domains (e.g., mobile, fixed, IMS).

dry_run.description: If true, simulate activation and return a plan without applying changes.

functions.returns: Activation status (or dry-run plan), including per-network element provisioning results and any failures.

functions.name: check_intercept_status
functions.description: Get the current operational and legal status of an intercept request.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Composite status including legal state (PENDING, ACTIVE, EXPIRED, SUSPENDED), technical state (PROVISIONED, PARTIAL_FAILURE, FAILED), and selected details.

functions.name: pause_or_terminate_intercept
functions.description: Temporarily suspend or permanently terminate an active intercept, including rollback of provisioning state.

reason.description: Reason for the lifecycle action (e.g., court order expired, technical issue).

effective_time.description: Optional future time for scheduled pause/termination.

rollback_on_failure.description: If true, attempt to rollback partial changes when some network elements fail.

functions.returns: Updated lifecycle status and per-network element results for pause/resume/termination actions.

functions.name: retry_failed_delivery
functions.description: Retry delivery of intercept metadata or content that previously failed to be delivered to a partner.

scope.description: Scope of failed deliveries to retry.

items.description: System-specific delivery failure codes to filter on.

force_alternate_channel.description: If true, use configured fallback channel where available.

dry_run.description: If true, report what would be retried without sending any data.

functions.returns: Summary of retry operations, including counts of retried items, skipped items, and any remaining failures.

functions.name: list_partner_intercepts
functions.description: List intercept requests associated with a partner and optional filters, supporting pagination and status filtering.
functions.returns: Paginated list of intercept requests with summary fields and pagination cursors/metadata.

functions.name: get_partner_profile
functions.description: Retrieve full configuration and compliance profile for a partner agency, including delivery channels and entitlements.

include.description: Sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Complete partner profile and requested sub-sections, suitable for audits or configuration review.

functions.name: update_partner_entitlements
functions.description: Modify the entitlements and compliance constraints of a partner agency (e.g., allowed intercept types, retention limits).

updates.description: Fields to update within the partner's entitlements and constraints.

suspension.description: Suspend or reinstate the partner's ability to request new intercepts.

change_request.description: Metadata about who requested the entitlement change and why.

ticket_id.description: Reference to internal change management ticket.

functions.returns: Updated partner entitlement profile and any impacts on existing intercepts (e.g., those exceeding new limits).

functions.name: audit_intercept_activity
functions.description: Query the immutable audit trail for intercept-related activities for compliance and forensic investigations.

include_details.description: If true, include full event payloads (subject to access controls).

functions.returns: Paginated list of audit events with metadata, including event type, timestamp, actor, and optionally detailed payloads.

functions.name: bulk_import_intercepts
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple intercepts from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined intercepts, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_intercepts
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of intercepts matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped intercepts with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_intercepts
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of intercepts with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_intercepts
functions.description: Export a filtered set of intercepts to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_intercepts_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across intercepts with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with intercepts hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_intercept_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on intercept lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_intercept_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing intercept subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_intercept_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a intercept subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_intercept_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single intercept with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across intercepts for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_intercept_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of intercepts.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_intercept_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to intercepts with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of intercept jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_intercept_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight intercept job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_intercept_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a intercept (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_intercept_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive intercept change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_intercept_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a intercept approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_intercept_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a intercept, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_intercept_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a intercept, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_intercept
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a intercept for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_intercept_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a intercept from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_intercept_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over intercepts (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched intercepts.

functions.name: build_intercept_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over intercepts data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_intercept_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern intercept behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_intercept_policies
functions.description: List policies governing intercepts with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_intercept_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a intercept and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
